title: Kethoxal-assisted single-stranded DNA sequencing (KAS-seq) for capturing transcription dynamics and enhancer activity
protocol: Prepare 500 mM N₃-kethoxal stock solution using DMSO.
Dilute the N₃-kethoxal solution into pre-warmed (37 °C) cell culture medium to a final concentration of 5 mM.
Incubate 1-5 million cells in the labeling medium for 10 min at 37 °C.
Harvest cells after incubation.
Isolate total DNA from cells using PureLink genomic DNA mini kit.
Elute DNA by using 50 µL 25 mM K₃BO₃ (pH 7.0).
Dilute 2 µg total DNA in 85µL of 25 mM K₃BO₃ (pH 7.0).
Add 10 µL 10× PBS to the solution.
Add 5 µL 20 mM DBCO-PEG₄-biotin (DMSO solution) to the mixture.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 1.5 h with shaking at 500 rpm.
Add 5 μL RNase A to the reaction mixture.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 15 min with shaking at 500 rpm.
Purify DNA from the reaction mixture by using a DNA Clean & Concentrator kit.
Elute DNA using 50 μL of 25 mM K3BO3 (pH 7.0).
Dilute 1 µg biotinylated DNA in 100 µL of 25 mM K3BO3 (pH 7.0).
Fragment the DNA by sonication using a Bioruptor Pico with a setting of 30s-on /30s-off for 30 cycles.
Save 5 μL of the fragmented DNA as input.
Use the remaining 95 µL of fragmented DNA for enrichment.
Wash 10 µL Dynabeads Myone Streptavidin C1 three times with 50 µL of 1× binding and wash buffer.
Re-suspend pre-washed beads in 95 µL of 2× binding and wash buffer.
Mix the beads with 95 µL of fragmented DNA from step 8.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 min with gentle rotation.
Place the mixture on a magnetic rack to remove the supernatant after incubation.
Wash beads five times with 100 µL of 1× binding and wash buffer.
Re-suspend the beads in 15 µL of nuclease-free water.
Heat the re-suspended beads at 95 °C for 10 min to elute enriched DNA.
Put the mixture on a magnetic rack.
Transfer the supernatant to a new labeled tube.
Heat the saved input at 95°C for 10 minutes.
Place both the input and eluted samples on ice immediately.
Perform library construction using the Accel-NGS Methyl-seq DNA library kit.
PCR amplify input samples for 7-8 cycles.
PCR amplify enriched samples for 12-14 cycles.
Sequence libraries on Illumina platforms in single-end mode.
Aim to get 30 million reads per sample.

Perform tagmentation on biotinylated DNA by mixing 23.5 µL DNA, 1.5 µL enzyme, and 25 µL Tagmentation DNA Buffer for 1,000 cells.
Incubate the tagmentation mixture at 37 °C for 30 min with shaking at 500 rpm.
Purify DNA from the reaction mixture using a DNA Clean & Concentrator kit.

Re-suspend pre-washed beads in 50 μL of 2× binding and wash buffer.
Mix the beads with 50 μL of fragmented DNA.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 min with gentle rotation.
Place the mixture on a magnetic rack to remove the supernatant.
Wash beads 5 times with 100 µL of 1× binding and wash buffer.
Adjust the volume of input to 20 μL by adding 15 μL of nuclease-free water to the 5 μL input saved previously.
Re-suspend the washed beads in 20 μL of nuclease-free water.
Prepare the PCR reaction mix with 20 µL of input DNA or bead suspension.
Add 2.5 µL of i5 index primer (Illumina 20027213).
Add 2.5 µL of i7 index primer (Illumina 20027213).
Mix with 25 µL of NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix (NEB M0544S).
Perform PCR reaction in a thermocycler.
Incubate for 5 min at 72 °C.
Incubate for 10 min at 95 °C.
Denature for 10 sec at 98 °C.
Anneal for 30 sec at 60 °C.
Extend for 1 min at 72 °C.
Repeat the cycles of denaturation, annealing, and extension for a total of 15 cycles.
Remove beads from enriched samples using a magnetic rack.
Purify the library using MinElute PCR purification kit (Qiagen 28004).
Sequence libraries on Illumina platforms in single-end mode with 30 million reads per sample.
